Mon: Choose a 30–60 sec clip from a U.S. professional speaker (🎯 Shadow tab → starter videos & channels).
Mark stressed words, pauses, contractions, linked sounds, intonation.
Shadow 6–8 times: listen → pause-repeat → speak with audio → speak alone.
Record yourself imitating the clip (use the recorder below).
Log what sounded weak + one sound/stress pattern to fix next time.
Tue: Write the prompt and your answer structure.
Bullet points only: context → issue → action → result / next step.
Listen back: mark filler words, grammar problems, vague wording, weak structure.
Write your top 3 corrections in the notes.
Wed: Study the 10–15 phrases + idioms for this week (Phrases tab).
Write 10 sentences of your own using your real work context.
Say all 10 aloud — record the best run.
Choose the best 5 phrases to actively reuse this week.
Thu: List: your role, the problem, what you need to say.
Record the simulated answer or discussion.
Review: where you rambled, got unclear, or needed stronger phrases.
Fri: Pick your weakest recording from this week.
Mark where the pace, stress or tone was flat or rushed.
Practice: slow down, stress key words, kill the monotone.
Shadow / drill the problem sections 6–8 times.
Self-score clarity / pace / naturalness in the notes.
Sat: Outline the talk (bullets, not a script).
Review: clarity, confidence, structure, pronunciation, filler words.
Sun: Listen to at least 2 recordings from the week.
Score the week below in the Reviews tab: clarity, fluency, pronunciation, business naturalness, confidence.
Write 3 wins, 3 weaknesses, 3 corrections for next week.
Review the phrase bank and keep 5 active phrases for next week.

weeks.goal: Build your baseline and start speaking clearly about yourself and your role.

Mon.task: Shadow a 45–60 sec clip of a U.S. professional introducing themselves. Transcribe, mark stress & pauses, shadow 6–8×, record.

Tue.task: Record a 90-second answer: current role → core responsibilities → previous experience → current focus.
Tue.out: Bullet outline · recording v1 · corrected v2

Wed.task: Build 15 phrases for introducing your role, then write 10 personal sentences using your real work.

Thu.focus: Explain your role to a non-technical person
Thu.task: Answer “What do you actually do at work?” as if speaking to a smart non-technical manager.
Thu.out: 2-min recording · list of overused technical words

Fri.task: Take Thursday's explanation: slow down, stress key words, reduce monotone. Record version 2.

Sat.task: Speak 3 minutes: “My background, my current role, and the type of work I want to grow into.”
Sat.out: 3-min recording · review of fillers, grammar, transitions

Sun.task: Listen to all recordings; list top 5 recurring problems; set next week's correction targets.
Sun.out: Weekly review completed in Reviews tab

weeks.goal: Speak clearly about ongoing work, progress, blockers, and next steps.

Mon.task: Shadow a 30–60 sec standup/update style clip.

Tue.focus: “What are you working on this week?”
Tue.task: Answer using: priority 1 → priority 2 → current progress → blocker → next step.

Wed.task: Build 15 update phrases (“This week I'm focused on…”, “The main blocker is…”) + 10 personal sentences.

Thu.task: “Can you give us a quick update on the data pipeline work?”

Fri.task: Redo your update with better pace and fewer fillers.

Mon.task: Shadow a clip where a speaker explains a problem or challenge.

Tue.task: “A dependency is delayed and will affect delivery.” Structure: issue → cause → impact → mitigation → ask.

Wed.task: Build phrases: “We've run into an issue with…”, “The root cause appears to be…”, “To mitigate that…”.

Thu.task: “Why is this task behind schedule and what's the recovery plan?”

Fri.task: Say the same explanation in a calmer, more concise way.

weeks.goal: Stop staying silent when things are unclear.

Mon.task: Shadow a clip focused on Q&A rhythm and polite clarification.

Tue.task: Practice aloud: “Can you clarify what you mean by…?”, “Just to make sure I understand…”, “Are you asking about X or Y?”.

Wed.task: Build phrases for clarifying, confirming, summarizing, follow-up questions.

Thu.task: You're in a planning meeting and requirements are vague. Ask 6 good questions out loud.

Fri.task: Record a calm, natural clarification exchange.

Sat.task: Simulate a meeting discussion: ask questions, summarize, confirm next steps.

Sun.task: Weekly review + complete the Month 1 dashboard in the Reviews tab.

weeks.theme: Explaining technical work to non-technical stakeholders
weeks.goal: Translate technical work into business language.

Tue.task: Explain a data pipeline or engineering task to a business stakeholder. No jargon unless you define it.

Wed.task: Build phrases: “In simple terms…”, “What this means for the business is…”, “The benefit is…”.

Thu.task: “Explain why data quality checks matter before reporting.”

Sat.task: 3-minute explanation of one real project to a non-technical leader.

Mon.task: Shadow a clip of a manager or consultant giving recommendations.

Tue.task: Answer using: context → options → tradeoff → recommendation → reason.

Wed.task: Build phrases: “What I'd recommend is…”, “The tradeoff is…”, “If speed is the priority, then…”.

Thu.task: Recommend how to handle a delayed dependency or data issue.

Fri.task: Same recommendation, but shorter and more executive.

weeks.goal: Speak with confidence without sounding aggressive or weak.

Mon.task: Shadow a clip of polite disagreement / discussion.

Tue.task: You disagree due to data or delivery risk. Respond professionally.

Wed.task: Build phrases: “I see the reasoning, but I have one concern.”, “My hesitation is…”, “I'd suggest we validate X before…”.

Thu.task: Push back on an unrealistic timeline.

Fri.task: Practice calm tone, not defensive tone.

weeks.goal: Perform in the actual meeting patterns you face.

Mon.task: Shadow a standup / planning / retrospective / project meeting clip.

Tue.task: Standup update with blocker + dependency + ETA.

Wed.task: Build phrases: “We're waiting on…”, “We may need to re-sequence…”, “To keep the sprint on track…”.

Thu.task: Run a 5-minute mock sprint update or retro discussion.

Fri.task: Compress your update to 60 seconds and keep it sharp.

Sat.task: Simulate: update → blocker → ask → next step → summary.

Sun.task: Weekly review + complete the Month 2 dashboard in the Reviews tab.

weeks.goal: Speak briefly, clearly, and with structure.

Mon.task: Shadow an executive update / business presentation clip.

Tue.task: Take a complex project and summarize it in 60 seconds.

Wed.task: Build phrases: “At a high level…”, “The headline is…”, “The next decision we need is…”.

Mon.task: Shadow an interview or professional networking conversation clip.

Tue.focus: “Tell me about a project you led.”
Tue.task: Answer with situation → task → action → result.

Wed.task: Build phrases for achievement, ownership, problem-solving, leadership, collaboration.

Thu.task: “Tell me about a challenge” · “Tell me about a conflict” · “Why are you moving into AI / engineering leadership?”

Tue.task: “Convince stakeholders to prioritize data quality / platform work / technical debt.”

Wed.task: Build phrases: “The reason I'm recommending this now is…”, “The cost of delay is…”.

Thu.task: Persuade a leader to approve a change or resource need.

Fri.task: Make it tighter and more confident.

Mon.task: Repeat a clip from Week 1. Shadow and compare with your Week 1 recording.

Wed.task: Review the full 12-week phrase bank and choose your top 50 phrases.

Thu.task: Full contribution: update → clarification → disagreement → recommendation → summary.

Fri.task: Repeat your weakest speaking task from the whole program.
